claim: The redesigned dashboard makes report generation quicker.
evidence: Analysts produced reports in less time using the redesigned dashboard than the previous version.

claim: The backup system preserves files during power outages.
evidence: During simulated power outages, files were lost despite the backup system being active.

claim: The new packaging keeps medicine stable during transport.
evidence: The medicine remained stable during refrigerated transport, but stability at room temperature was not assessed.

claim: The irrigation method conserves water.
evidence: In a controlled trial, fields using the method consumed 22% less water than fields using conventional irrigation.

claim: The intervention increases reading scores.
evidence: Students receiving the intervention scored lower than students in the comparison group.

claim: Remote work increases employee productivity.
evidence: Remote work participation was correlated with higher employee productivity ratings.

claim: The revised curriculum improves course completion.
evidence: In a randomized evaluation, students assigned to the revised curriculum completed courses at a higher rate than the control group.

claim: The protective coating prevents corrosion.
evidence: Corrosion developed on coated samples during controlled salt-spray testing.

claim: All customers can access the platform without restrictions.
evidence: Platform access was available only to premium subscribers.

claim: The filter removes 90% of chlorine.
evidence: Chlorine concentration was 90% lower after filtration.

claim: The machine reduces waste by 30 kg per day.
evidence: Waste fell by 12 kg per day under the same production volume.

claim: The sensor reduces false alarms by 20%.
evidence: Under the same test protocol, the sensor increased false alarms by 20%.

claim: The program improves employee mental health.
evidence: Participants reported better sleep, but anxiety and depression were not assessed.

claim: The treatment does not increase adverse events.
evidence: Adverse-event rates were unchanged between the treatment and placebo groups.

claim: The new protocol reduces medication errors.
evidence: Medication errors were more frequent under the new protocol than under standard practice.

claim: The device improves signal strength and battery life.
evidence: Signal strength increased, but battery life declined.

claim: The therapy reduces symptoms in patients with moderate disease.
evidence: The therapy reduced symptoms in patients with mild disease.

claim: The sensor detects gas leaks.
evidence: Preliminary findings suggest that the sensor may detect some gas leaks.

claim: The sensor measures room temperature within 0.5 degrees Celsius.
evidence: In calibration trials, sensor readings differed from the reference by no more than 0.5 degrees Celsius.

claim: The platform supports offline access.
evidence: The platform requires an internet connection for every session.
